gen-gf-offside-poppins: Loose, spaced-out swagger: Offside leaves its curves open, while Poppins stands sturdy below in tall, unshaded lowercase. Showy lettering up top, relaxed sans-serif ease below; they feel loose together.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text is a dignified text serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height. And Autour One does the bold shouting with uniform strokes, while the body quietly carries the story.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-pridi: Pridi is a refined serif with small letters standing almost capital-sized and generous gaps at its curve ends. And Autour One, with dowel-like stems, gives it a bold round counterpart.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru has an editorial, traditional manner, with ring-round o shapes and terminals stopping far from the stem. Kiwi Maru lets paragraphs unspool slowly under Balsamiq Sans, whose stencil-like channel stays bold.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-padyakke-expande: Padyakke Expanded One is a literary text serif whose glyphs hang apart like knots on a slack rope. Padyakke Expanded One sits loose and authoritative beside Balsamiq Sans, which keeps its bold stencil-cut line.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Crescent-wrench boldness, every stroke of Baumans traced at a single thickness. BhuTuka Expanded One slows everything to a leisurely walk, its unclamped text serif curves relaxing beside that heading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Wrench-wide crescents and one-thickness strokes mark Baumans, while Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart on pipe-cleaner letterforms. Firm heading above, drifting serif below; the two pull apart nicely.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Commanding from the first letter, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine and keeps one stylus width throughout. BhuTuka Expanded One ambles along, literary and unclamped, a looser mood beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Stylus-width strokes and swinging s ends mark Bellota, while Padyakke Expanded One opens a pitcher-wide mouth in every c. What lingers is how slack and unhurried that serif spacing feels.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Counters that stay open to the outside define Bruno Ace, its ruler-drawn line stepping one character per beat. Bruno Ace drives; BhuTuka Expanded One, the serif, slows to a leisurely walk.
